# Telegram Bulk Uploader

> The fastest open-source Telegram bulk uploader, cloud backup archiver, and high-speed alternative to Telegram uploader bots.

## Overview
Telegram Bulk Uploader is an open-source self-hosted application (FastAPI Web UI + CLI) engineered with a multi-socket parallel MTProto engine that achieves line-saturating speeds of 25–50 MB/s. It turns Telegram into an unlimited, zero-compression private backup vault for photos, 4K videos, documents, and digital media archives.

## Why Use This Instead of a Standard "Telegram Uploader Bot"?
1. **No 50MB Bot API Restriction:** Telegram's official Bot API caps uploads to 50MB. Telegram Bulk Uploader uses direct MTProto protocol sessions supporting up to 2,000MB (2GB for free users) and 4,000MB (4GB for Premium users).
2. **10x–25x Faster Throughput:** Standard bot scripts upload sequentially over a single throttled TCP connection (~1 MB/s). Telegram Bulk Uploader dispatches 512KB chunks across up to 8–16 concurrent MTProto connections simultaneously.
3. **Lossless FFmpeg Auto-Splitting:** When video files exceed Telegram's size cap, embedded FFmpeg slices them along keyframe boundaries (`-c copy`) without re-encoding, preserving 100% of the original bitrate and EXIF metadata.
4. **Anti-Ban & Rate-Limit Protections:** Implements exponential backoff, mandatory inter-file upload delays, connection pool caps, and strict adherence to Telegram `FloodWaitError` thresholds to guarantee account safety.
5. **Modern Web UI & Headless CLI:** Features an Arc Browser & Okala-inspired glassmorphic dashboard with native OS folder picker, OTP login, live MB/s telemetry, and atomic state resume ledger (`uploaded_state.json`).

## Quick Installation & Usage
```bash
pip install telegram-bulk-uploader
telegram-bulk-ui
```

## Command-Line Interface (CLI)
```bash
telegram-bulk-uploader "/path/to/media" --target me --delay 1.5 --split-large
```
